entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to process a return for an order I placed a while back. My order number is VF886753.
I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up order VF886753... I see it's for the Men's Pro-Line jersey. What specifically is the issue with it?
The jersey is just the wrong size for me. I ordered my usual large, but this one is way too tight across the chest and shoulders. I was hoping to return it.

I see. It looks like this was delivered about 55 days ago. Let me just quickly check our return policy for you... Okay, good news. Since this is a standard apparel item, you're still well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to exchange it for the next size up?

That's great news. An exchange for an extra-large would be perfect. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and sending it back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my trouble? Maybe 10% off my next order?

I'm happy we can get that exchange started for you. While I can't offer a discount code for a sizing issue, I can confirm that we will cover the return shipping costs completely. You won't be out of pocket for sending the wrong size back to us.
Okay, that's fair. As long as the shipping is covered, I'm happy. So what are the next steps for the exchange?

Perfect. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack up the jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you.
Got the email. This looks straightforward. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
